encoding.R: distance to nearest road centerline, 0..255 maps 0..40 m (clamped)
encoding.G: class of nearest road: 0 none (beyond distMax), 64 track, 128 gravel, 192 park_paved, 255 highway

mapping: worldX = originX + (px + 0.5) * res; worldZ = originZ + (py + 0.5) * res; u = (worldX - originX) / (width * res); v = (worldZ - originZ) / (height * res)
